steps.label: Line-up!
steps.note: This conga line up is not strictly required, but it helps you find who should be left or right.

steps.label: Shapes + Debuffs
steps.note:
- Each player is assigned a shape with a partner of the same shape 
(X, square, O, triangle)

- Everyone gets either Mid Glitch (Close) or Remote Glitch (Far)

- 2 random players are assigned with the Near & Distant World debuffs

steps.label: Male + 2 Arms spawn
steps.note:
- Male becomes new relative North. It can spawn on any cardinal or intercard wall

- 2 Laser Arms spawn relative SW and SE of Omega Male. 
(An arm targets the furthest player from it)

steps.label: Line-up on Male
steps.note:
Line-up by pair like so!
- In this case, we mimicked the pattern used in P2 - Party Synergy

steps.label: Shapes Disappear
steps.note: At this point, you may forget your shape for the remainder of the Trio w/ this strat.

steps.label: 6/8 Players are marked
steps.note:
Each pair will be either...
- 1-marked pair
- 2-marked pair

steps.label: Move to respective waymarkers
steps.note:
Each pair will be either...
- 1-marked pair
- 2-marked pair

steps.label: Northmost 1-marked pair
steps.note:
Northmost 1-marked pair
- NW (no-mark) & SE (marked)

Southmost 1-marked pair
- NE (no-mark) & SW (marked)

Northmost 2-marked pair
- North & South 
- Left player stays North

Southmost 2-marked pair
- East & West

steps.label: Southmost 1-marked pair
steps.note:
Northmost 1-marked pair
- NW (no-mark) & SE (marked)

Southmost 1-marked pair
- NE (no-mark) & SW (marked)

Northmost 2-marked pair
- North & South 
- Left player stays North

Southmost 2-marked pair
- East & West

steps.label: Northmost 2-marked pair
steps.note:
Northmost 1-marked pair
- NW (no-mark) & SE (marked)

Southmost 1-marked pair
- NE (no-mark) & SW (marked)

Northmost 2-marked pair
- North & South 
- Left player stays North

Southmost 2-marked pair
- East & West

steps.label: Southmost 2-marked pair
steps.note:
Because it's Mid Glitch (Close)..
- All players must be front of their Waymarkers

steps.label: [Mid Glitch (Close)]
steps.note:
Because it's Mid Glitch (Close)..
- All players must be front of their Waymarkers

steps.label: [if it's Remote Glitch (Far)...]
steps.note:
If it's Remote Glitch (Far)...
- All players must be behind their Waymarkers at the wall

steps.label: Remember your Waymark
steps.note:
1 of 2 macros will be pressed at the beginning of Sigma Version:
- CLOSE + Smiley
- FAR + Star

Find new relative North for towers and position accordingly.
----------
TOP PF Macros:
https://pastebin.com/qUJY054s

steps.label: ABCD
steps.note:
ABCD
- Always in bottom towers (regardless of Close Smiley or Far Star patterns)

1 & 2
- Always taking the top towers

3 & 4 (Close + Smiley Only)
- Taking W & E towers

steps.label: KB -> MIDDLE of tower
steps.note:
Because it's Close + Smiley...
- All players must be in the center of their towers

---

Credits to Marielle Glace of Faerie for the mspaint pic!

steps.label: ABCD
steps.note:
ABCD
- Always in bottom towers (regardless of Close Smiley or Far Star patterns)

1 & 2
- Always taking the top towers

3 & 4 (Far + Star only)
- Taking SW & SE towers

steps.label: KB -> WALL of tower
steps.note:
Because it's Far + Star...
- All players must go to the wall of their towers

---

Credits to Marielle Glace of Faerie for the mspaint pic!

steps.label: Prepare for Near/Distant World
steps.note:
- Check if you have Near or Distant World debuff

Prepare for the last half of Trio 2!

steps.label: Final Omega, Female, & 2 Arms spawn
steps.note:
Final Omega spawns center

Female will spawn on 1 of the waymarks (she becomes North)
- 2 Laser Arms spawn SW & SE of Female

steps.label: 3 players to Female
steps.note:
3 players must be chosen to go to Female

Priority to Female:
- Must have 1 stack of Dynamis
- Cannot have Near/Distant World Debuff

In this case, the choices are between:
- DRK, SAM, PLD, DRG, & SMN

steps.label: Near & Distant World players
steps.note:
Near & Distant players are free to preposition opposite of Female on the correct side:
- Near World 1st in line close to laser
- Distant World 2nd in line

steps.label: 3 remaining players Tenstrike with Near/Distant Worlds
steps.note:
3 remaining players tenstrike with Near/Distant:

1st in line towards aoe = 1st Near baiter
2nd in line towards aoe = 2nd Near baiter
3rd in line towards aoe = 
Far baiter

steps.label: Check Female
steps.note:
Female will do either..
- Hot Wing (In is safe)
- Cross aoe (Out is safe)

In this case, it's Out is Safe
DON'T GET JEBAITED

steps.label: Rotating AOEs begin
steps.note:
Make sure to solve Female AOE before deciding to..
- Move in with aoe
or
- Wait for aoe to go off

steps.label: Solve Female aoe (Go in or WAIT)
[Caution]
steps.note: Looking inwards, the Arm Baiter on the left must wait until the spinning aoe ends.

steps.label: Positions
steps.note:
Near & Distant Worlds
- Must be 1 ring in front of markers 

Everyone else
- Hug the wall

steps.label: Near/Distant World
steps.note:
Near/Distant World debuffs expire

Arms shoot at the 2 furtherst players from them

steps.label: WE DID IT
steps.note:
By the end of Trio 2, you must have...
- 4 players w/ 2 stacks
- 4 players w/ 1 stack
